name: Smart Brief
description: A summary that scales with the recording: a few lines for short clips, structured sections for long ones.
outline: Judge the length and density of the transcript and size the note to match: two or three sentences for a short clip, structured sections for a long one.
Always open with a one-sentence statement of what the recording is about.
For longer recordings add a Key Points list and group related points under short headings.
Mention names, numbers, dates and commitments exactly as spoken.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## In Short
A 5-minute voice note about moving the launch.

## Key Points
- New date is 12 May
